text:
Liam: reserving 02:00-03:00 UTC quiet window tonight for orders schema migration. planning a small index add + background backfill throttle. ping if conflicts.
Sara: ack, I'm the runbook owner for this migration. I'll be oncall starting 01:30 UTC.
Jamie: I can own rollback + smoke tests. what's the expected traffic during that hour? :thinking: 
Liam: traffic expected ~5% of normal. backfill will run at low qps; plan is: 1) add index, 2) flip dual-write flag, 3) start backfill with rate=50r/s, 4) monitor errors and latency.
Priya: please drop the runbook link and confirm DB creds rotation window.
Sara: runbook here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/orders-schema-migration — see the "Quick checks" and "Rollback" sections.
Sara: DB creds rotation is at 03:30 UTC so we're good.
Jamie: smoke test checklist I'll perform after index add:
```
1) write/read a sample order via public API
2) verify index size < 500MB
3) 95th percentile latency < 200ms for order reads
4) no replication lag > 5s on replicas
```
Liam: rollback plan summary: flip dual-write off, stop backfill job, drop new index if creation failed, promote old index path. Jamie, you own step 2 (stop backfill + verification).
Jamie: noted. I'll prepare scripts: db-scripts/rollback.sh and run a dry-run in staging at 22:00 PT.
deploy-bot: quiet-window reserved by @Liam from 2026-05-02T02:00:00Z to 2026-05-02T03:00:00Z :white_check_mark:
Priya: request: add an autopause feature flag for backfill. if error rate > 1% then pause and alert.
Liam: created feature flag: flag.order_index_migrate.autopause = true. backfill manager supports autopause on error threshold.
Sara: who will be the named pusher for audit? we need one person recorded in the runbook who executes the schema apply.
Liam: I'll be the pusher for the schema apply. Jamie will run the backfill.
Jamie: I'll run the backfill and monitor logs. tail cmd I'll use:
`kubectl logs -f deployment/orders-backfill -n prod | grep backfill`
Priya: confirm we have a replica warmup plan — if primary is busy smoke tests may flake.
Sara: yes — we pre-warmed read replicas and primed KV cache. ops checklist shows all replicas in Ready state.
Liam: final call for objections: if no objections by 23:30 PT we proceed with the window.
Priya: no objections from me.
Jamie: ok from me.
Sara: ok. I'll post a short status ping in #incidents if we see any degradation.
Liam: thanks all — adding owners to the runbook and tagging oncall. good luck :rocket: 
db-admin-bot: scheduled backup snapshot created: snapshot-20260502-0105 (id: snap-12345)
Liam: backup confirmed.
